description: Objets trouvés en gare d'Angers Saint-Laud en temps réel is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. List of objects found in Angers Saint-Laud station in real time. This list includes only items found 10 days after a declaration of loss has been registered. Coverage: Région des Pays de la Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Objects found in Angers Saint-Laud station in real time" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région des Pays de la Loire. Its keywords include mobilite, gare-de-voyageurs, objets-trouves, services-en-gare. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2016-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
